limits: Small synchronous metadata/console observer overhead may change scheduling. No awaited read/delay was inserted before reload.

The original local baseline failed all four executions after immediate reload with DOM selection differing from committed IndexedDB selection while the old chat remained stored. This reproduces the selection-save race under these synchronous observers; small observer overhead remains, and this alone does not establish every hosted CI failure cause.
Committed selection is observed from actual existing IDB get results and completed book-put transactions; no new diagnostic IDB request was created.
Only synthetic fixture IDs/counts/image-presence and save-status text recorded; no brief text or photo bodies.
Fixture-only local installed Playwright Chromium; no paid/live provider, database, secret or deployment operation.
